page.overview:
Who is A.D. Doug?

When Loki began time-slipping, Agent Mobius took him to Ouroboros, who was initially skeptic until Loki slipped back in time and talked to Ouroboros in the past. O.B. explained that Mobius needed to use a Temporal Aura Extractor to extract Loki from the Temporal Loom while Loki self-pruned. He and Mobius deployed it into the Temporal Loom, creating a physical timeline which tied Loki to the present. Loki's condition was stabilized, but TVA experienced power fluctuations, and O.B. realized that the multiversal branches were overwhelming the Temporal Loom. When B-15 rejected the option of pruning the branches, Ouroboros indicated that the only alternative was sealing the blast doors leading to the Temporal Loom while he developed modifications for it to accommodate the branches.

As the door to the Temporal Loom could only be opened by Miss Minutes or He Who Remains, Loki and Mobius located a Variant of him named Victor Timely on a branched timeline and brought him into the TVA to work with O.B. on the Throughput Multiplier to scale the capacity of the Temporal Loom. During this time, Timely and O.B. discovered that they were fans of each other, as O.B. authored TVA Official Handbook based on Timely's journal, which itself was only possible by him receiving a copy of the Handbook in the past.

Despite O.B.'s efforts, the Temporal Loom overloaded and the entire Time Variance Authority was ordered to be evacuated. Running out of time, Loki volunteered himself to launch the Throughput Multiplier, but Timely insisted on taking the risk. The temporal radiation in the Loom chamber had risen dramatically, and the moment the airlock blast doors opened and Timely stepped outside, Victor was spaghettified into non-existence shortly before the Loom exploded. Thrown again, Loki had manage to master his Time Slipping and returned to the time before the Loom's explosion. Having realized what he needed to do, Loki used his Asgardian magic to breach the blast doors and destroy the Temporal Loom. The others watched as timeline branches began to die, but Loki used his powers to gather and maintain them during his ascension, leaving his friends behind but safe.

The new TVA had redirected its efforts towards protecting the new Multiverse and hunting the Variants of He Who Remains. O.B. had reprogrammed and reactivates Miss Minutes to be more helpful and less murder-prone.
